ordering_proof: this file is committed and pushed to the factory's public GitHub repository (wavemedix/Ammonix_insurance_claims) before any Qwen3.8-generated correspondence text, any Qwen3.8-text decision, or any episode result under this registration exists anywhere; the pushed commit is the public timestamp. The prior registration (comparison_qwen38_model_swap) kept the world-text channel on Qwen3.6 and produced a tranche-99 result (agentic 39.4 / agentic_rag 47.7) that used Qwen3.6 correspondence; that result and the 135 Qwen3.6 remainder texts it generated are discarded here and regenerated under this registration.
reason: The release owner is retiring Qwen3.6 across the Ammonix products: every live model role moves to Qwen3.8. The prior registration moved only the agent's decision seat to Qwen3.8 and deliberately kept the world-text channel on Qwen3.6 (cardessa/textgen.py pins it, to avoid forking a frozen corpus). Retiring 3.6 means the text channel moves to 3.8 as well. This registration records exactly what that entails and what it does NOT touch.
what_moves_to_qwen38: the agentic-LLM baseline decision seat (arm 'agentic') on its head-to-head draws
the agentic-LLM-with-retrieval decision seat (arm 'agentic_rag') on its draws
the L-swap plain-Qwen writer seat on the 200 demonstration claims (525 decision points)
the world-text channel (cardessa/textgen.py) for any correspondence NOT already present in the frozen historical corpus
frozen_historical_corpus: The 17,898 correspondence/indication texts generated by Qwen3.6 during the published runs (data/text_cache, prompt-hash-keyed, created before 2026-09-15) are treated as FROZEN, read-only data. They are NOT regenerated. Regenerating them would change the world every published arm stands in — the shipped Ammonix agent, Sol, Claude, the GPT-6 lanes — and would invalidate the published head-to-head numbers, the demonstration, and the 4.7x GPT-6-token claim. That is a different and larger experiment and is explicitly out of scope here. A generated corpus is fixed data once written; retiring the generator does not un-freeze it, exactly as retiring a random seed does not require redrawing a published sample.
qwen38_remainder: Fresh Qwen3.8 decisions steer a small number of episodes into claim states whose correspondence is not in the frozen corpus. Measured over the completed sealed draws under the prior registration, this remainder was 135 texts, ~0.75% of the 18,033-text corpus. Under this registration those states' correspondence is realized by Qwen3.8, consistent with the model retirement, and the count actually generated is reported alongside the results. This is a disclosed, quantified extension of the frozen corpus, not a silent re-forking of it.

model_pin.replaces: Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ-INT4 in both the decision seat and the world-text channel
model_pin.serving: local vLLM, same flags as the 3.6 pin: temperature 0, seed 0, JSON-schema-constrained decoding for decisions, thinking disabled via the chat template, max-model-len 4096, one Qwen model on the GPU at a time (it now serves both text and decisions, so within a step there is no Qwen-to-Qwen swap; the only rotation is Qwen3.8 <-> the 9B writer, as in the original published pipeline)
model_pin.fresh_caches: the 3.8 arms use fresh, separate decision cache directories (decisions_qwen38_full, decisions_rag_qwen38_full) and the 3.8 writer its own draft cache (data/m1_qwen38); no 3.6 decision, draft, or discarded 3.6-text remainder is reused

unchanged: The shipped-agent arm, the simulated-biller arm, the Sol and Claude arms, the imitation and oracle arms, the Ornith writer arms, the payer reader (pinned Haiku), the sealed episode draws, the engine, the scoring, all tie bands, and the frozen historical corpus are untouched, and their published numbers do not change.
decision_rule: All re-run numbers are reported as measured, replacing the corresponding Qwen-3.6 cells and derived prose (margins, standard errors, claim-level win counts, retrieval lift) in the paper; nothing is selected, dropped or re-drawn. If the 3.8 baselines beat the shipped agent on any draw, that is reported. Tie bands and scoring are exactly those of the original registrations (comparison_v6_tranche99, comparison_rag_tranche100, comparison_tranches101_102, and the l_swap protocol).
provenance: Requested by the release owner on 2026-09-16, superseding the 2026-09-15 model-seat swap, so that no Ammonix product or paper depends on the retired Qwen3.6 generation while the published world corpus, demonstration, and 4.7x claim remain the frozen record they already are.
